foot.not_advice: It is not medical advice. It cannot diagnose, and nothing here should change a screening or treatment decision without your own clinician. Criteria, doses and guideline statements are quoted as published. Please check the original sources, which are listed in full in the Sources module.
shell.disclaimer: The Colorectal Cancer Companion is an educational synthesis of published literature for study and patient understanding. It does not replace a doctor, nurse or screening programme. Doses, criteria, survival figures and guideline statements are reported as published, not as instructions or a prognosis for any individual. Anyone with symptoms should see a clinician, whatever their screening history.
shell.note: An animated, cited guide for students, people facing screening or a diagnosis, and their families. Educational only, not medical advice. Your place is saved on this device.
